newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Computer Learning cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Computer Learning cut.

text.p: -- Everen Securities Inc said Friday it cut its near-term rating for Computer Learning Centers Inc to market perform from outperform due to valuation. Its long-term rating remains outperform.
-- Computer Learning shares were unchanged at 28-3/4, its 52-week high.
-- The company's fundamental outlook remains strong, Everen said. Its earnings estimates remain $0.90 a share for fiscal 1998, compared with $0.76 a share, and $1.10 for fiscal 1999.
